description: This file contains functions related to symbolic type inference, unification of types, and type substitution within a PyTorch FX graph, specifically focusing on unification and refinement of tensor types in the context of automatic differentiation or graph transformations.

methods.name: infer_symbolic_types_single_pass(traced)
methods.description: Performs a single pass of symbolic type inferencing on a traced FX graph.

methods.name: infer_symbolic_types(traced)
methods.description: Performs multiple passes of symbolic type inferencing to resolve complex type relations such as broadcasting.

methods.name: convert_eq(list_of_eq)
methods.description: Converts a list of equality constraints into a tuple format suitable for the unification library.

methods.name: unify_eq(list_of_eq)
methods.description: Applies unification to a set of equality constraints, converting them into a substitution mapping.

methods.name: substitute_solution_one_type(mapping, t)
methods.description: Applies the unifier mapping to a single type, substituting type variables with their corresponding types.

methods.name: substitute_all_types(graph, mapping)
methods.description: Substitutes types throughout a graph's nodes, applying unification results until reaching a fixed point.

methods.name: check_for_type_equality(g1, g2)
methods.description: Checks if two FX graphs are equivalent based solely on the equality of their node types.
